utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll stick to the plan and check in later if I hear anything myself.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the cracked edge near the curb and that loose patch by the gate. I can point them out when you’re over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll swing by and take a look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — can you confirm the drop-off time again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I’ve got a small list, mostly tools and patch kits. I’ll bring it by and show you what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—bring it by whenever you’re ready, and I’ll sort through it with you. I may forget a thing or two, so feel free to remind me what goes where.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you share the exact details for the repair drive first? I want to make sure I get it right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I don’t have the exact details on me yet. I’ll check and get back to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll wait for the exact details before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not much yet — we were just getting organized. I can catch you up and point you to where we need help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — I’m here now and can help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could you bring your cordless drill and a box of screws? I’ll handle the rest and meet you by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Gus — I’ll bring the cordless drill and a box of screws. I’ll meet you by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where things are for the repair drive. What location should I note first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s start with the school gym — that’s where we’re collecting the repair drive items.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve noted the school gym as the collection spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve been hearing people set aside all kinds of repair stuff for the drive. If you want, I can keep an eye out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess—thank you! I’ll start spreading the word and let everyone know to send the repair stuff your way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Quinn—I’ll watch for anything folks drop off and tell you what’s still needed. Thanks for helping get the word around!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we set the repair drive date yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet — I haven’t heard a date confirmed. I can check with the others and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please do, and let me know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and tell a few neighbors about it. If you want, I can repeat the details to anyone who missed them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I tend to hear things second-hand anyway. If you mention it, I’d appreciate the basics too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the basics and make sure anyone who missed it hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and want to make sure we cover the most urgent fixes first. Do you know which homes or blocks need attention right away?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure about the whole block, but my place has a leak that’s gotten worse. If you’re making a list, I’d put that near the top.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh no — I’ll put your leak near the top of the list. If you can, send me your address and a quick note about where it’s coming from.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already. If you need the details, I can pass along what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. Just let me know the time and where folks should drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check on the exact time and drop-off spot, then I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I just need help sorting the donated tools and then I’ll tell everyone the pickup plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help sort the donated tools now. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I still need to sort the sign-up list and check which tools are missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the sign-up list and look over the tool list too. Just point me to what you have.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just the exact location and a quick note on what needs fixing, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s by the back fence near my place, and the gate latch needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do we need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you start by checking what’s missing and what’s already been promised? I want to make sure we know the details before we ask anyone for anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s missing and what’s already promised, then I’ll share a clear list with you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you help sort tools and check in with folks at the hall? If you can, I’ll put your name on the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that. Put my name on the list and I’ll head over to the hall to help sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re still on track for Saturday morning—got a few folks signed up and I can bring my tool kit. If you need anything fixed, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—Saturday morning still works for me. I’ll think of anything I need fixed and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what’s the repair drive need help with?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly hands-on help: sorting donations, carrying boxes, and checking what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that — I’ll sort donations, haul boxes, and check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where everything needs to go first so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — the repair drive starts Saturday morning at the community shed, and everything should go there. If you want, I can send the exact drop-off list too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, thank you. If you send the list, I can make sure I bring the right things at the right time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away—people around here usually pitch in fast. Want me to let everyone know the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please do. I’ll send over the time and place right now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, send it over and I’ll pass it along right away. I’ll make sure folks in the neighborhood hear about it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what time does the repair drive start, and does it conflict with school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still not sure on the start time, but I’ll check and let you know. I don’t think it should mess with school pickup, though.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that helps—just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive notes ready, Nell—let’s make sure we’ve got the list of needed fixes and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—if you can tell me the fixes and who’s bringing what, I’ll keep track and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect—I’ll send you the fixes and the supply list next, and we’ll keep everything moving.
